title: What's New: Reporting (For Developers) (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: New AL layout features: overriding properties and obsoleting
Runtime layout features in report layouts page
Layout management: validation, Excel properties, and troubleshooting
Word layout enhancements and metadata features

features.name: Override Excel multiple data sheets property at layout level
features.description: Developers can now override the Excel layout multiple data sheets property at the layout level in AL, allowing individual layouts to have different settings than the report default without affecting existing customer layouts.

features.name: Obsolete report layouts using AL
features.description: Developers can now mark report layouts as obsolete using the obsolete tag in AL, similar to deprecating other AL objects, with support for obsolete state and reason.

features.name: Set Excel layout properties in report layouts page
features.description: Users can now set the Excel layout multiple data sheets property directly when creating or editing layouts in the report layouts page, in addition to the AL-level setting.

features.name: Validate report layouts
features.description: A new validate action allows users and developers to check if report layouts have any issues. Currently validates RDL layouts in 26.0; Word and Excel validation coming in a next minor release.
caveats: Word and Excel validation coming in next minor release

features.name: Show layout info action
features.description: A new action shows detailed information about report layouts including system ID, type, creator, modifier, obsolete status, and last modified details. System ID can be matched with telemetry custom dimension for troubleshooting.
caveats: Creator and modifier information only populated for user-imported or user-created layouts, not extension or app-provided layouts

features.name: Standard BC report information in Word layouts
features.description: Word layouts now have access to standard metadata and request information through a new BC report information section in the XML mapping, including report name, title, help text, environment, company, user, language, and date/time hierarchy.
caveats: Requires manual mapping in Word XML

features.name: Word layout date/time hierarchy
features.description: Word layouts can now access a structured hierarchy of year, month, day, hour, and minute from the request metadata, allowing developers to format dates and times in custom ways without hard-coding.

features.name: Obsoleting reports developer documentation
features.description: Updated developer documentation provides guidance on obsoleting both report layouts and reports in general, including how to communicate changes to users through request pages, help panes, and layout pickers, plus telemetry tracking.
